cost_model: per-trade round-trip cost = (entry_notional + exit_notional) * (slippage_bps/10000), reported at three per-side bp levels on notional; a separate paper-fidelity-only column additionally applies the paper's own $0.0035/share commission so results are comparable to the published numbers without blending the two conventions
borrow_or_financing: none for SIP01/SIP02 (long-only, no short borrow); SIP03 (long-short diagnostic) prices a 0.3%/year annualized borrow fee prorated by holding minutes on short legs, matching this project's own H-20260918-02 ETF-ORB convention, since the paper itself does not disclose a borrow-cost assumption

stop_fill_variants.same_bar_conservative: gap-through-stop fills at the bar's own open; if both the stop and (in a future candidate that adds one) a target are touched within one bar, the stop is assumed to fire first -- this project's standing conservative convention
stop_fill_variants.one_bar_late_qc_forum_variant: protective stop is not considered live until the bar AFTER the entry bar, per claim_id orb_qc_one_bar_late_stop_fill_and_alpaca_execution_risk (QuantConnect forum commenter Yuri Lopukhov); reported alongside the conservative variant, not in place of it
